verdict.rationale: Column documents sending and receiving international transfers over SWIFT via its API, and claims access to over 150 currencies. Nothing in the evidence describes FX rates or their transparency, and a currency count is not a documented coverage map of currencies and corridors. Missing for 10: documented FX rate transparency (rates, markups, quotes), an explicit currency/corridor coverage map, independent or hands-on corroboration of international wires.

support.subject: As a founder, money can cross borders — international wires or SWIFT, FX with transparent rates, and the coverage map of currencies and corridors documented

citations.quote: Via our APIs, you can send and receive international transfers through the SWIFT network.
Access over 150 global currencies through our network and bring simplicity to your international transfers.
we receive full raw data for all domestic and international wires.
